email.subject: Logs Insights — count timeouts last 30m
email.body:
Need a count from the logs.

WHAT HAPPENED
Checkout timeouts spiked. The lines are already in CloudWatch Logs.

WHAT YOU NEED TO DO
1. Open CloudWatch, Logs Insights.
2. Use log group /finova/payments.
3. Set the time range to Last 30 minutes.
4. Query messages that contain timeout and count the rows.

DO NOT
Do not delete the log group.

REPLY WITH
How many timeout lines you counted.

— On-call
